scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && OPEN_NEXT_DEPLOY=true wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && OPEN_NEXT_DEPLOY=true wrangler deploy
scripts.upload: npm run build && OPEN_NEXT_DEPLOY=true wrangler versions upload

CF_TOKEN.description: Runtime Cloudflare API token used by Mailflare onboarding to call the Zones and Email Routing APIs. Cloudflare's deploy/build token is not passed to the app, so create this separately at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens with `Zone Read`, `Email Routing Edit`, and `Email Routing Rules Write` permissions for the zones you will connect. Outbound mail uses Resend and does not need Email Sending permissions. Paste only the token secret value, without `Bearer`.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key used to verify login and first-run registration challenges. Pair with NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY at build time.

NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile public site key used by the login and first-run registration widgets.

CF_EMAIL_WORKER_NAME.description: Worker name used when creating Cloudflare Email Routing rules. Set this to the deployed Worker name; if you rename the Worker, update this value too.

GITHUB_UPDATE_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token for the installation repository with Actions: write permission, Contents: write read permission. Used only by the admin update endpoint to dispatch update.yml.

GITHUB_UPDATE_REF.description: Optional branch used to dispatch updates. Leave blank to use the repository default branch.

GITHUB_UPDATE_REPO.description: Your github repository that connect to cloudflare worker

CF_EMAIL.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Use this with `CF_API_KEY` instead of `CF_TOKEN`.

CF_API_KEY.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Prefer `CF_TOKEN` for new deployments.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key for outbound mail. Add as a Worker secret. Verify your mailbox sender domains in Resend first.

RESEND_SENDING_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated exact sender domains already verified in Resend, for example kashyapadvisors.com. This is a local allowlist, not an automatic DNS verification check.

RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret for the Resend email.sent webhook pointing to https://YOUR_APP/api/resend/webhook. Used to match incoming replies to Sent messages.
